title: Full Stack Engineer(.NET, React, JavaScript, and Python 3 to 4 year exp)
description:
**Company Description**
Cognior is an AI-first startup focused on transforming how businesses drive customer adoption of digital platforms. The company combines a modular orchestration layer with intelligent analytics to streamline user onboarding, engagement, and compliance. Its AI-powered Adoption Platform (DAP) captures real-time behavioral data and provides contextual insights with minimal engineering overhead. Cognior’s plug-and-play solutions scale across industries such as BFSI, healthcare, manufacturing, and education. The team is dedicated to turning complex digital workflows into intuitive, user-friendly experiences for enterprises.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Ernakulam for a Full Stack Engineer (3 to 4 year exp ) specializing in .NET, React, JavaScript, and Python. The engineer will design, develop, and maintain end-to-end web applications, including building robust backend services and APIs, and implementing responsive, user-centric interfaces. Daily responsibilities include writing clean, testable code, integrating frontend and backend components, optimizing performance, and collaborating with product, design, and data teams to deliver new features. The role also involves troubleshooting and debugging issues, contributing to architectural decisions, and participating in code reviews and continuous improvement of development practices. The engineer will work closely with the AI and analytics teams to integrate platform capabilities into scalable, secure solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Back-End Web Development and Software Development, including experience with .NET and Python.
* Proficiency in Front-End Development using React, JavaScript, and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).
* Experience in Full-Stack Development, integrating frontend and backend services into cohesive applications.
* Solid understanding of web application architecture, RESTful APIs, and database systems (SQL/NoSQL).
* Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows.
* Knowledge of secure coding practices, performance optimization, and scalable system design.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and communicate clearly.
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and CI/CD pipelines is an advantage.

title: Engineering Manager – PHP & Web Tech
description:
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead software engineering teams, optimize delivery processes, and drive people development across multiple product teams. The role primarily focuses on engineering team management, delivery excellence, Agile execution, and stakeholder collaboration rather than hands-on development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage software engineers and cross-functional teams to ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
* Drive sprint planning, roadmap execution, delivery tracking, and risk management.
* Coach engineers and Technical Leads, manage performance, and support career development.
* Monitor engineering KPIs, including DORA and SPACE metrics, to improve productivity and delivery predictability.
* Establish effective Agile practices, CI/CD workflows, release governance, and quality standards.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and senior leadership to resolve dependencies and delivery blockers.
* Promote team engagement, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Proven engineering management experience, including managing teams of 5+ engineers.
* Strong people leadership, mentoring, performance management, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Experience with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
* Knowledge of DORA metrics, engineering delivery KPIs, CI/CD, and software release processes.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, delivery commitments, and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong communication and distributed-team management skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Previous experience in software development or technical leadership.
* Familiarity with PHP, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, or API gateways.
* Experience with SaaS products, API-driven applications, and cloud-native platforms.
* Knowledge of SRE, platform reliability, and engineering process transformation.
